def probeGates {ι : Type u} {R : Type v} : RationalFormula ι R → ℕ

  | .const _ => 0
  | .add f g => probeGates f + probeGates g + 1
  | .sub f g => probeGates f + probeGates g + 1
  | .mul f g => probeGates f + probeGates g + 1
  | .div f g => probeGates f + probeGates g + 1

theorem probe_leaves_le_gates {ι : Type u} {R : Type v} (f : RationalFormula ι R) :
    RationalFormula.variableLeaves f ≤ probeGates f + 1 := by
  induction f with
  | var _ => simp [RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]
  | const _ => simp [RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]; omega
  | sub f g hf hg => simp only [RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]; omega
  | mul f g hf hg => simp only [RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]; omega
  | div f g hf hg => simp only [RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]; omega

    (f : RationalFormula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ)
    (H : (n : ℝ) ^ 4 / (192 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) ≤
      (RationalFormula.variableLeaves f : ℝ)) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ 4 / (384 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) ≤ (probeGates f : ℝ) := by
  have hn' : (32 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith

  have hle : (RationalFormula.variableLeaves f : ℝ) ≤ (probeGates f : ℝ) + 1 := by

  have h3 : (32:ℝ)^3 ≤ (n:ℝ)^3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hn' 3
  have h4 : (384 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 4 := by

    rw [this]
    nlinarith
